system.description:
Grit; 4 Pierce; Long (150 ft). Heavy: each Strike costs an Attack and an Interact Action. Two-hander: needs both hands free. Spray'n'Pray: every other enemy within 5 ft of the target must pass a CR 1 Luck Check or also be hit by the Strike.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.141
